title: ess-history/1
description: One recorded concurrent run, as declared by models/concurrent-history/. A Returned operation carries returned_at and outcome; an Indeterminate operation carries neither and is read as returning after every other operation. Draft 04 is used because it is the draft in which a number written with a decimal point or an exponent (7.0, 7e0, 1e1) is not an integer, which is what the reader admits.

seed.description: The seed the run was drawn from. A plain non-negative integer, at most 2^53-1 (9007199254740991), the largest a writer holding numbers as doubles writes exactly. Only the plain integer spelling is admitted: 7.0, 7e0 and 1e1 are refused.

clients.description: A plain positive integer, at most 2^53-1 (9007199254740991). Only the plain integer spelling is admitted: 2.0 and 2e0 are refused.

Uuid.description: A UUID in lower-case canonical hyphenated form; one identity has one spelling.

client.description: A plain non-negative integer below the history's clients, at most 2^53-1 (9007199254740991). Only the plain integer spelling is admitted.

invoked_at.description: The invoke instant: a reading of a monotonic integer clock the writer chooses. The unit is not fixed; the checker compares instants only by order, so one history uses one clock. A plain non-negative integer, at most 2^53-1 (9007199254740991). Only the plain integer spelling is admitted: 1e1 and 10.0 are refused.

returned_at.description: The return instant, on the same monotonic integer clock as invoked_at and no earlier than it, or null. A plain non-negative integer, at most 2^53-1 (9007199254740991). Only the plain integer spelling is admitted.

rows.description: For a Returned read of a view: the identity of each row it answered with, in the order answered. Absent on a command and on a read that could not record it; the checker judges no read without it.

retry_of.description: For a client retry: the operation_id of an earlier operation of the same client and command whose request this one sent again, unchanged. Written only when a runner injects the faults a specification declares, for a command declaring a replays branch. Absent on every other operation.
